title: Is 220 Total Cholesterol High at Age 35?
description: Yes — 220 mg/dL puts you in the 'borderline high' range, and 41% of adults 35–44 with this level have early artery plaque. Learn how.

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking Google articles on cholesterol for adults universally cover the basics: what cholesterol is (essential lipid vs. high levels causing plaque buildup), types (LDL 'bad', HDL 'good'), causes (diet, genetics, age), effects (heart disease, stroke risk), healthy levels (total <200mg/dL, LDL <100, HDL >40-50), testing frequency (every 4-6 years after 20, more often for high-risk), and management via diet, exercise, and meds.
